title: Episode 12
logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 11's cliffhanger where the Constable pulls Gerald's planted gold pocket watch from Alexander's trench coat.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.60)
Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.60)
Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.

blocks.speaker: CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:00.50) | End: (00:04.50)
"Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft."

Start: (00:04.60) | End: (00:09.10)
Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:04.60) | End: (00:09.10)
Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:06.00)
Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:06.00)
Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Furious, Defiant):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:05.70) | End: (00:08.80)
"No! That watch was not in his coat!"

Start: (00:09.10) | End: (00:11.80)
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:09.10) | End: (00:11.80)
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CONSTABLE (Blunt, Unyielding):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:10.00) | End: (00:11.70)
"I found it there myself."

Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:13.90)
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:11.80) | End: (00:13.90)
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Passionate, Accusatory):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:12.30) | End: (00:13.90)
"Then someone put it there!"

Start: (00:13.90) | End: (00:20.80)
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:13.90) | End: (00:20.80)
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Smug, Condescending):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:14.30) | End: (00:20.60)
"The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."

Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:23.70)
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:20.80) | End: (00:23.70)
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Low, Steady, Dangerous):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:21.60) | End: (00:23.60)
"I have never touched your property."

Start: (00:23.70) | End: (00:26.90)
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:23.70) | End: (00:26.90)
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Mocking, Malicious):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:23.70) | End: (00:26.80)
"Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."

Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:28.00)
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:28.00)
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Enraged, Shouting):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:27.90)
"You planted it!"

Start: (00:28.00) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:28.00) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Purring, Taunting):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:28.10) | End: (00:30.00)
"Oh, dear sister..."

Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:31.00)
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:31.00)
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:32.40)
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:32.40)
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Continuing taunt):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:32.40)
"...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"

Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:35.30)
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:35.30)
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:35.20)
"Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."

Start: (00:35.30) | End: (00:40.00)
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:35.30) | End: (00:40.00)
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Smooth, Derisive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:35.40) | End: (00:40.00)
"You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."

Start: (00:40.00) | End: (00:41.80)
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:40.00) | End: (00:41.80)
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Scheming):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:40.10) | End: (00:41.50)
"Perhaps I can give you one."

Start: (00:41.80) | End: (00:43.70)
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:41.80) | End: (00:43.70)
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Guarded, Cold):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:42.20) | End: (00:43.50)
"What do you want?"

Start: (00:43.70) | End: (00:46.60)
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.70) | End: (00:46.60)
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:44.00) | End: (00:46.40)
"I want to see you crawl, sister."

Start: (00:46.60) | End: (00:52.40)
Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:46.60) | End: (00:52.40)
Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:46.70) | End: (00:52.30)
"My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."

Start: (00:52.40) | End: (00:56.80)
Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:52.40) | End: (00:56.80)
Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:52.40) | End: (00:56.70)
"...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."

Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:58.00)
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (00:58.00)
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (01:00.80)
Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:56.80) | End: (01:00.80)
Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:57.30) | End: (01:00.60)
"You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."

Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:03.20)
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:03.20)
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:00.80) | End: (01:03.10)
"A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"

Start: (01:03.20) | End: (01:05.20)
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:03.20) | End: (01:05.20)
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:03.30) | End: (01:05.10)
"Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
blocks.action:
Start: (01:03.30) | End: (01:05.10)
"Do it, and we withdraw the charges."

blocks.text:
Start: (01:05.20) | End: (01:09.50)
Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:05.20) | End: (01:09.50)
Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

blocks.speaker: CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:05.40) | End: (01:09.20)
"Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."

Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:14.00)
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:09.50) | End: (01:14.00)
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:09.60) | End: (01:11.20)
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:09.60) | End: (01:11.20)
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:09.80) | End: (01:13.80)
"Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."

Start: (01:14.00) | End: (01:21.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:14.00) | End: (01:21.80)
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:14.20) | End: (01:16.00)
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:14.20) | End: (01:16.00)
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:15.30) | End: (01:18.20)
"I am not letting them take you."

Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:23.00)
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:21.50) | End: (01:23.00)
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:27.21)
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:21.80) | End: (01:27.21)
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:22.80) | End: (01:24.70)
"Tell me where the garden is."

Start: (01:24.70) | End: (01:27.21)
Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:24.70) | End: (01:27.21)
Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.
